compiled_state.title: Update .test-index with RED markers and record RED baseline
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

This task makes structural updates to .test-index to register the RED test created in the preceding task. No behavioral logic is added; this is purely infrastructure wiring so the pre-commit test gate accepts the failing test.

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: Integration test suite can be run and confirmed FAILING (RED); failing run output recorded as ticket comment: .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment <this-story-id> "RED confirmed: <test output summary>"
- DD4: Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified test scaffold logic (the stub helpers in Task 1 have no conditional logic — no separate unit tests needed; this task verifies the scaffold is exercised and the RED run is recorded)

## Implementation Notes

### .test-index update
Add entries mapping pr-comment-response.sh to the integration test:

plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh: tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh

Add RED markers for the failing test functions, e.g.:
[test_fetch_produces_normalized_json_schema] tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
[test_reply_in_thread_root_comment_id_resolved] tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
[test_accept_comment_produces_commit] tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
[test_defend_comment_defense_comment_id_non_null] tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
[test_defer_comment_ticket_id_in_json] tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
[test_no_real_api_calls_escape] tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh

### RED baseline recording
After verifying the test is RED (exit non-zero), record the output:
  TEST_OUTPUT=$(bash tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh 2>&1 || true)
  SUMMARY=$(echo "$TEST_OUTPUT" | tail -5)
  .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment b3b3-9463 "RED confirmed: $SUMMARY"

### run-integration-tests.sh check
The run-integration-tests.sh already discovers test-*-integration.sh files automatically. Verify the new test is discovered:
  bash tests/integration/run-integration-tests.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "test-pr-comment-response"

## File Impact
| File | Action | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| .test-index | modify | Add pr-comment-response.sh entries + RED markers |

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Escalation Policy
Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] .test-index contains mapping for plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh
  Verify: grep -q "pr-comment-response.sh" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] .test-index contains at least one RED marker for a test in test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
  Verify: grep -q "\[test_" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index && grep "test-pr-comment-response" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index | grep -q "\["
- [ ] Integration test is discovered by run-integration-tests.sh
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/integration/run-integration-tests.sh 2>&1 | grep -q "pr-comment-response"
- [ ] RED baseline recorded as ticket comment on b3b3-9463
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show b3b3-9463 | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('PASS' if any('RED confirmed' in c['body'] for c in d.get('comments',[])) else 'FAIL')"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null; true

comments.body: CHECKPOINT: RED markers for all 8 test functions added to .test-index in commit a3d78d108e alongside the test file creation. RED baseline confirmed: PASSED 7 / FAILED 8 recorded on story b3b3-9463
